# Nagasaki Culture Telecasting

, also known as NCC, is a television network headquartered in Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan.  It is affiliated with All-Nippon News Network.  TV Asahi Holdings and Asahi Shimbun are the main shareholders of NCC.
Nagasaki Culture Telecasting is the third commercial television station in Nagasaki prefecture.  It was started broadcasting in 1990,  and started digital terrestrial television broadcasting in December 2006. In 2020, NCC started to use its new master control room.
Unlike the televisions in Nagasaki,the headquarters set among Urakami sta.,Nagasaki Brick hall,and next to Nagasaki Shinbun,both Asashin and Nagashin are NCC's shareholder,make NCC become the rarest get shareholder from both.
The newspapers can write NCC in many ways like:
Sankei Shinbun Kyushu/Yamaguchi:Nagasaki Bunka
Nagasaki Shinbun:NCC
The 3 big newspaper(Asashin,Maishin,Yomishin):NCC Nagasaki Bunka(included Saga Shinbun)
Nishinippon Shinbun:NCC Nagasaki Bunka Housou
Nihon Keizai:Nagasaki Bunka NCC
The slogan is "Viva!Nagasaki Bunka!" the mascot of the televisions are Morinokigoro and Mameta with P-chan(pet). but when NCC released,the slogan is "Centrifugal wave, centripetal wave ",NCC has a award from Japan Commercial Broadcasting Association for showing footage from an big campaign,is"2-day marching in Shimabara peninsula,Toward to the all-union peace life with Mt.Unzen",this is the first award that NCC received from a big organization,later in 2019,NCC got an award by JCBA for taking news for an special program.
